name: Yamaha reface DX
description: Yamaha reface DX FM synthesizer: every parameter of its data list by parameter change, the four operators each, and Pull from its bulk dump.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/yamaha/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/yamaha/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 1C 05 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 53 06 00 00 00 7F F7.

The reface sends and receives control changes for its panel only with MIDI Control on (the system setting); this profile edits by parameter change, which the data list prints for every setting, and does not map the control changes.
Pull: Bulk dump request (SYSTEM Common); Bulk dump request (Voice Common, Operator 1, Operator 2, Operator 3, Operator 4). 135 of 135 parameters are read back.

coverage.editBufferDumpRequest: complete: every bulk dump block the data list lists

parameters.name: Master Tune
parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0 : bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0 : bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0 : bit 7-4 4th bit 3-0 : bit 3-0. Printed: -102.4 – +102.3 (cent).

parameters.name: Tempo
parameters.description: 2 bytes: 1st bit 6-0 : bit 13-7 2nd bit 6-0 : bit 6-0. Printed: 30 – 300.

parameters.name: Voice Name
parameters.description: 10 characters, one per address from 30 00 00, 32 – 126 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.

parameters.name: Part Mode
parameters.description: MONO-FULL: applied to all notes MONO-LGATO: applied only to notes played legato.
